## Phase 1 review

- [ ] Existing functionality and architecture are preserved.
- [ ] No paid services, API keys, secrets or purchased assets are introduced.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] New geographical / terrain assets have a documented licence and provenance.
- [ ] No Phase 2 aircraft or flight-dynamics work is included.
